periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation slanting downward toward the rostrum at approximately a 60-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the visual mass of the patch is concentrated below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness; the band occupies the full visible extent of the shoulder and lateral upper torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the dorsal surface of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regularly rounded semicircular apex with smooth convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent reddish-brown (rufous) staining of the fur on the lower abdomen and perineal region.
